audit.note: No advisory fix was applied and no gate is waived.

npmTree.note: The same existing TypeScript and optional Base peer incompatibilities remain.

review.visual: Dev and preview desktop/mobile screenshots inspected; no overflow or overlapping controls observed. Screenshots use controlled public responses, not live receipt evidence.
fixtureCorrections: Enter keyboard modality before checking :focus-visible after a pointer-driven wallet connection.
Corrected a syntax error in the added static-bundle assertion before the final matrix started.

reproduction.fixtureScope: Actual app and SDK in all SDK cases. Controlled HTTP/chunk failures except live cases. Body timeout uses a synthetic Response stream; late deliberately ignores native abort. Synthetic wallet events exercise real wagmi integration.
reproduction.walletAccessNote: Wagmi performs one initial provider probe in idle contexts. The harness compares SDK preparation/read access counts against that baseline and requires zero wallet requests unless Connect was explicitly clicked in a synthetic wallet scenario.
reproduction.nodeUnitScope: Node SDK doubles cover orchestration with real ethers/viem; real SDK validation and transport behavior are established by the browser matrix.
reproduction.source: Current committed src/ats.ts, src/App.tsx and src/deployment.ts; no separate candidate implementation.

limitations: The SDK path uses the disclosed local ATS 8.0.0 export/provider patch; this is not an upstream-supported read-only API.
SDK config acceptance does not establish full SDK/VC or transaction compatibility. B1 remains bounded; B2, VC and human acceptance remain open.
Mobile is desktop Chrome viewport emulation, not mobile wallet acceptance. The new main-app SDK controls have not received real MetaMask human acceptance.
The manifest, lock, wallet/guard/style source and retained patches are unchanged. Existing advisories, peer incompatibilities and missing dfns license metadata remain recorded.
No signature, transaction or transaction ID. No automatic push, merge, VC or NOVA creation.
